leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize multiple state variables using separate useState hooks in a React component
Update individual state variables independently without affecting other state values
Construct event handlers that manipulate specific state variables based on user interactions
Configure controlled form inputs that bind to different state variables
Implement conditional rendering logic based on multiple state variable values
Apply state updates to control the visibility and behavior of UI elements
Integrate multiple state variables to create interactive user interfaces
